_readme: Pi's RPC wire vocabulary, for the tables BOTH the Go provider and the TS renderer plugin read. Pi's stream is JSONL where every envelope carries a top-level `type` and an extension UI request carries a `method`, so those strings ARE the dispatch keys on both sides -- a drift between two hand copies stops a row rendering rather than failing a build. The Go-only vocabulary (the client->server `PiCommand*` names) stays in pi_protocol.go, per the contracts rule's one-side-only exemption. LeapMux does not own these values, so a change here follows Pi's protocol rather than leading it.
